- Confirming panel: Dev leads coding (algorithms/optimization), Marissa covers model infra + inference tradeoffs.
- Time: 2025-11-05 11:00 PT (that is 19:30 IST). Candidate noted evenings IST are okay; please be mindful that 19:30 IST is near his evening.
- Platform: please use CoderPad for the coding portion (shared pad + audio). I created a draft pad at https://coderpad.io/p/abcd-ml-screen — please use that exact pad and paste the prompt in the first 2 minutes.
- Prompt: see attached coding-prompt.pdf (short prompt + test cases).
- Interviewer length: please block 1 hour on your calendar to allow a 10-min buffer for overruns and 5-min debrief afterwards.
- Candidate materials: Priya, can you confirm the candidate's GitHub and any pre-work? Dev, please let us know if you need to run the pad locally or want a Codesignal alternative.

I'll send the formal calendar invite and an .ics that includes the CoderPad link + internal debrief doc. For evaluation, use the ML Systems rubric (link to Drive in the invite) — we care about problem approach, correctness, optimization, and tradeoff discussion.

Hannah

1) Can Priya paste the candidate's GitHub repo or a link to the specific project you want me to look at?
2) Will CoderPad have a Python/C++ runtime that preserves performance reasoning? I sometimes like to run a micro-benchmark if we get to optimization discussion. If CoderPad is flaky we can move to a Zoom + local editor flow (I can share my screen).

Interviewer checklist (please read before the interview):
- Open the CoderPad and paste the prompt at the top.
- Start with 5 minutes of clarifying questions, then 35–40 minutes of paired coding, leaving ~10 minutes for tradeoffs + infra discussion.
- Use the rubric: approach (0–3), correctness (0–3), optimizations (0–3), communication (0–2). Fill out the quick debrief doc immediately after the interview.

Backup plan: if CoderPad fails, Dev will share screen and we will use the Zoom room + single-file on Google Drive.
